name: hypertransport_link_isaac
display_name: HyperTransport serial link at 1.6 GHz, 6.4 GB/s (ISAAC, 32 nm)

area.citation: shafiee2016isaac Table I p.8 ('Hyper Tr links/freq 4/1.6GHz ... 22.88', 'link bw 6.4 GB/s'; 'Chip Total ... 85.4 mm2')
area.derivation: ISAAC's four off-chip HyperTransport links take 22.88 mm2 at 32 nm (Table I, the DaDianNao link model of Section VII): 22.88 / 4 = 5.72 mm2 per link; a node-to-node link of the multi-chip system, beside the 168 tiles' 62.5 mm2 of an 85.4 mm2 chip.
